title: OrchestratePlan
description: Task graph for /orchestrate. Written by the planner during Phase 1 at <workspace>/plan.json. Adapted from Cursor's plan.schema.json minus Slack/cloud fields.

goal.description: Verbatim user goal, the full agent-facing text.

rootSlug.description: Kebab-case identifier; used in <workspace> path and as default scoping for descendants.

baseBranch.description: Default startingRef for tasks without their own. Typically the planner's current branch at kickoff.

id.description: Kebab-case unique identifier within plan. Used as handoff filename and combined with rootSlug as the `<rootSlug>-<id>` worktree name passed to claude-bg-wait.

name.description: Same as id; kept for parity with Cursor's schema.

scopedGoal.description: Outcome the task must achieve. The only steering signal — worker reads this, plus acceptance, to know what to do.

pathsAllowed.description: Globs the task may modify. (Optional; default = no restriction.)

pathsForbidden.description: Globs owned by siblings; worker must NOT touch.

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria the worker must hit. Verifier targets check these too.

verify.description: Markdown verification recipe (Setup / Automated / Manual / Gotchas). Workers read as target behavior; verifiers inherit from target.

startingRef.description: Branch or ref the worker should reset its worktree to. Defaults to plan.baseBranch. For verifiers, auto-set by planner to target's branch after target hands off.

dependsOn.description: Upstream task ids. Gates spawn AND triggers context relay (upstream handoffs pasted into downstream spawn prompt). For verifiers, target id auto-added.

measurements.description: Quantitative drift detection. Worker self-reports under ## Measurements; planner reruns each command on worker branch and flags >10% drift to attention.log.

model.description: Optional subagent model override (opus | sonnet | haiku). Useful for retry-with-different-model on tool-error failures.

verifies.description: Verifier-only. The target task id this verifier checks.
